name: quesee
displayName: QueSee: Call Scoring, Churn Risk & Customer Experience
description: Find out why customers call, complain and cancel. Score 100% of customer calls against your own SOP, coach agents on the exact steps they miss, and get a ranked list of customers at risk of churning with the next step to save each one. Built for contact center, support and retention teams at broadband, telecom and other service providers. Read-only, with names and contact details replaced.
